description:
Triii Therapeutics is a natural supplement brand built around two structured programs: the Trilogiii Core and Boost weight loss 14-Day Reset and the 30-Day Protocol. Instead of leaving customers to guess what to take and when, Trilogiii gives them a defined path, built on 40+ essential nutrients, prebiotics, and probiotics, delivered by BIACTIN. We call it Intelligently Designed Foundational Elements. What sets Trilogiii apart is structure and honesty: no guessing, no filler ingredients, and messaging that stays disciplined about what a natural supplement can and can't claim to do.

As a Triii Therapeutics Health Affiliate, you earn a 30% commission on a new customer's first qualifying purchase, tracked through a 90-day cookie window. Commissions are paid out monthly via Wise (bank transfer) once your balance reaches the $100 minimum. It's a single, one-time commission per new customer, no multi-month schedule, no residual, no override, so the terms are simple and easy to explain to your own audience.

You'll promote Trilogiii using your individual referral link, distributed automatically once you're approved, along with a set of approved advisor scripts and content you're expected to use as-is rather than freelancing your own product claims. This matters to us: Trilogiii is a supplement, not a drug, and we hold every advisor to the same compliance standard we hold ourselves to. If that sounds like a program you want in on, apply today. Questions before you do? Reach us at affiliates@triii.life.

In a preliminary human study, Trilogiii users lost an average of 12.7 lbs at 4 weeks.*

*Based on a preliminary human study with hundreds of participants. The study used a single-group, start-and-endpoint design and did not necessitate a randomized placebo comparison. Participants used the complete Trilogiii protocol (all four products + lifestyle guidance). Individual results may vary. Full data analysis and publication now pending. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
